'''Mouhamed Saer Sene''' is a [[Senegal]]ese [[basketball]] player who is projected to be drafted in the [[2006 NBA Draft]].  He is noted to be a great defensive player because of his 7' 8½" wingspan and great athletism.  

He only began playing basketball in 2003.
